Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 9 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: three-seat sofa with wide arms, size unknown
image 3: shaggy high-pile area rug, 170 cm wide, 240 cm deep
image 4: square light wood coffee table, 70 cm wide, 70 cm deep
image 5: long TV console with open shelves, 174 cm wide
image 6: rectangular shade floor lamp, size unknown
image 7: green linen-look cushion, size unknown, 2 units
image 8: areca palm in a nursery pot, size unknown
image 9: white sheer tab top curtains, pair, size unknown

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Es el living de mi departamento, con salida al balcón. Quiero un living moderno y luminoso para recibir amigos: un sofá de tres cuerpos gris claro contra la pared de la izquierda, una mesa ratona de madera clara, una alfombra grande que arme la zona, una lámpara de pie y un mueble bajo para la tele enfrente del sofá. Almohadones y una planta para darle color.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
